paper.title: Modification of a commercial activated carbon with nitrogen and boron: Hydrogen storage application

defaults.verified_by: Agent B (sonnet): 279 cells, 0 numeric disputes, 0 vocabulary/policy violations; all 13 uptakes, BET, DR V0, mesopore Vm and XPS at.% confirmed, modelled/MDA values confirmed excluded. Agent C adjudication: per-sample source_location (Table 2 cited only on XPS samples); co-doped dopant_element='B, N' endorsed (first multi-element value; comma-space delimiter; no code filters the field); notes record that Vm is a by-difference value from a single-point total and that BET carries +-10%. All 13 rows Tier B.

notes.type: uptake_type=excess (exact-word rule): Fig 3 and Table 5 are headed 'hydrogen excess adsorption'
notes.sa: bet_surface_area_m2_g is BET with the Rouquerol criterion (Table 1, carries +-10%); micropore_volume_cm3_g is the DR micropore volume V0; mesopore_volume_cm3_g is Vm, a by-difference value (total pore volume at p/p0=0.99 minus V0, Table 1 footnote c); pore_volume_method=DR/N2 describes V0; the total pore volume VT is not tabulated separately and is not reconstructed (arithmetic avoided)
notes.psd: Horvath-Kawazoe micropore distribution is bimodal (~0.68 and ~0.80 nm), not a single average, so no average pore diameter is recorded
notes.mda: the Dubinin-Astakhov (MDA) extrapolations in Table 6 (5.11/5.69/6.65 wt% at 10/15/30 bar; the 1-bar values in parentheses; the 7.86 wt% system figure, which is total adsorbed+compressed) are modelled, not measured, and are not extracted
notes.method: H2 excess adsorption on a Micromeritics 3Flex (static volumetric), -196 C, 0 to 0.93 bar; degassed under vacuum; He pycnometry gives the skeletal density used for the volumetric-density calc; H2 purity and sample mass not stated
notes.base: base carbon is a commercial coconut-shell granular activated carbon (Haycarb USA); synthesis_method=commercial for every sample; modifications (He thermal treatment, NH3 doping, borax-decahydrate B impregnation) are in activation_method
notes.codope: co-doped (N and B): the schema holds one dopant field, so dopant_element records 'B, N' (comma-space) and the concentration is left empty; XPS was not reported for the two co-doped samples
notes.noxps: XPS surface composition is reported only for AC, AC-He400, AC-N500, AC-He400-N500, AC-B, AC-B-He400, AC-He400-B-He400 (Table 2); dopant concentration is left empty for the other doped samples
notes.ncon_native: the reported surface N includes the carbon's native N (~0.6-0.7 at.% in the undoped AC), not only the ammonia-added N
notes.bcon: the reported surface B is total B; XPS B 1s resolves into BCO2 (in-matrix) and B-O (Na2B4O7/B2O3) fractions (Table 3)
notes.onebar: Chahine caveat (section 5): a 0.93-bar cryogenic row is near 1 bar, where the BET/500 saturation bound does not apply; the chahine point is a by-hand 1 (within physical bounds, not a saturation test). Tier B either way
